Name: Elliot replacer - earlier development version
Author: Thoroughly
Description:
This mod completely replaces the NPC and bachelor Elliot with an earlier version which was used during development, but has since been scrapped by the game's creator. 

All portraits and sprites have been replaced by earlier game files when possible, and redrawn by me when otherwise. Let me know if there are other instances of his face/sprite ingame which I've missed, or if there are graphical glitches I haven't noticed ingame.

I also made some minor edits to his posture and clothing, ie. got rid of the bowlegged thing most NPCs have going on, plus other small changes you probably won't notice.
